### GAME ON. LEVEL UP. OWN THE NIGHT

TOKEN2049 brings the Web3 world together.

But when the conference ends...

THE GAME BEGINS.

Welcome to SPARKY: GAME ON!, a high-energy GameFi and Web3 nightclub experience bringing together gamers, founders, builders, investors, KOLs, creators, communities and Web3 enthusiasts for one unforgettable night in Singapore.

This isn't a conference.

This isn't a panel.

This isn't another networking mixer.

It's GameFi brought to the dance floor.

Get ready for six hours of music, entertainment, drinks, dinner, networking, giveaways and GameFi energy, all under one roof during TOKEN2049 week.

THE GAME STARTS HERE

High-Energy DJ Experience

Dance through the night with an energetic lineup designed to keep the party moving.

Unlimited Drinks

Enjoy unlimited drinks throughout the event.

Dinner Included

Come hungry - dinner is included for approved guests.

GameFi & Web3 Community

Connect with people building the next generation of gaming, blockchain and digital experiences.

Founder & Investor Networking

Meet Web3 founders, investors, VCs, builders and ecosystem leaders in a relaxed nightlife environment.

GameFi Experiences & Activations

Discover SPARKY and connect with GameFi projects, gaming communities and ecosystem partners.

Giveaways & Surprise Rewards

Special prizes, community activities and partner giveaways throughout the night.

Content & Social Moments

Create content, meet creators and capture the moments that make TOKEN2049 Week unforgettable.

Nightclub Energy

Music, lights, drinks, dinner and a packed Web3 crowd - all night long.

### WHAT MAKES GAME ON! DIFFERENT?

Most TOKEN2049 events give you another room to talk.

GAME ON! gives you a reason to play.

This is where gaming culture meets Web3 culture, where builders meet players, where communities meet creators, and where business connections happen naturally without the conference-room atmosphere.

PLAY

Experience the energy of GameFi, interactive activities and gaming culture.

LEVEL UP

Discover new projects, communities, creators and opportunities across Web3.

CONNECT

Meet the people building the next generation of gaming and digital experiences.

PARTY

Dance, celebrate and enjoy one of the biggest nights of TOKEN2049 week.

### WHO IS THIS NIGHT FOR?

Web3 Founders

Connect with other founders, investors and potential ecosystem partners.

GameFi Builders & Gamers

Meet the people creating the next generation of blockchain gaming.

Investors & VCs

Discover projects, teams and emerging opportunities across Web3.

Builders & Developers

Exchange ideas and connect with teams building new products and infrastructure.

Creators & Influencers

Meet communities, brands and creators from across the global Web3 ecosystem.

Degens & Web3 Enthusiasts

If you love Web3, music, nightlife and meeting interesting people - you're invited.

### WHY ATTEND?

Because TOKEN2049 doesn't have to end when the conference floor closes.

Come for the GameFi.

Stay for the music.

Meet the people behind the industry.

Challenge yourself.

Win something.

Make new connections.

And level up your TOKEN2049 experience.

One night. One massive community. One unforgettable GameFi experience.

Limited capacity. Registration does not guarantee entry, applications are reviewed before approval.

### HOW TO GET APPROVED

We want to bring together an energetic and engaged Web3 community while keeping the event exclusive.

To qualify for approval, attendees must complete the following community steps:

STEP 1 - FOLLOW SPARKY ON X

Follow the official Sparky account:

𝕏 [Twitter: https://x.com](https://x.com/TheSparkyVerse)[TheSparkyVerse](https://x.com/TheSparkyVerse)

STEP 2 - JOIN THE SPARKY TELEGRAM CHANNEL

Get Sparky game updates, announcements and event information:

TG Channel: https://t.me/SparkyTapGame

STEP 3 - JOIN THE SPARKY COMMUNITY GROUP

Join the Sparky community and connect with fellow players and Web3 enthusiasts:

TG Group: https://t.me/SparkyOfficialchat

STEP 4 - SUBMIT YOUR REGISTRATION

Complete the event registration form with your professional details and social profiles.

STEP 5 - GET APPROVED

Our team will review applications based on event capacity, attendee profile and community fit.

Only approved guests will receive final confirmation and entry details.

REGISTRATION NOTES

- Registration does not automatically guarantee entry.
- Event capacity is limited and organizers reserve the right to approve or decline applications.
- Approved guests must present their confirmation at check-in.
- Guests must meet the nightclub venue's applicable age requirement.

### SPARKY

PLAY. EARN. LEVEL UP.

SPARKY is a Telegram Mini App GameFi ecosystem combining gaming, community engagement and Web3 mechanics through a Phoenix-themed gaming experience.

Players can tap, spin, complete activities and evolve their Phoenix while participating in the growing SPARKY ecosystem.

The broader SPARKY ecosystem is designed around GameFi mechanics including staking, NFTs, on-chain gameplay, token utility and community-driven growth.

Website: https://www.sparky.zone

### MINIAPPS STORE

DISCOVER THE NEXT GENERATION OF MINI APPS

MiniApps Store is focused on the growing world of mini apps and the opportunities created by frictionless, community-driven digital experiences.

As part of SPARKY: GAME ON!, MiniApps Store brings its ecosystem perspective to a night connecting Web3 builders, creators, developers, communities and innovative digital products.

Website: https://miniapps.store

### GFI STUDIO (GAMEFI STUDIO)

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF GAMEFI

GFI Studio brings a dedicated GameFi and gaming ecosystem perspective to the event.

The collaboration with SPARKY creates an environment where GameFi founders, builders, gamers, investors, gaming communities and Web3 professionals can connect, exchange ideas and discover new opportunities.

Website: https://gfi.studio

### MA MARKETING

MOMENTUM AMPLIFY MARKETING

Great products need more than technology.

They need positioning, visibility, community, users and growth.

MA Marketing helps Web3, B2B, SaaS and technology companies turn products into brands and marketing strategies into measurable growth.

As the Growth & Marketing Partner for SPARKY: GAME ON!, MA Marketing is supporting event growth, community activation, brand visibility, partnerships and audience engagement.

Website: https://ma-marketing.space

### SPARKY × MiniApps Store × GFI Studio × MA Marketing

To bring the Web3 community together after dark.

GameFi

Mini Apps

Web3 Growth

Community

Music

Networking

### About the event

Join The Best Event at Elevation, a premium brunch opening the second morning of race weekend exactly as it should - unhurried, high above the city, with the Grand Prix atmosphere already building outside.

### Event Highlights

- A refined morning gathering with a discerning crowd - founders, investors, and the industry's most connected
- Freshly baked pastries and light bites, served throughout
- Front-row views as the F1 track builds toward race-day energy
- Sweeping skyline views that set an elegant tone for the day ahead
- Quality networking with the types of people who stay for the spectacle

Elevation is hosted at Singapore's most premium penthouse suite, in an iconic 5-star hotel overlooking Marina Bay. With floor-to-ceiling views of the F1 Track, this premium space reflects the calibre of company you can expect and a level of exclusivity you shouldn't miss.

[The Best Event](https://www.instagram.com/_thebestevent?utm_source=luma) is the global event series where Web3 comes to life. With over 120+ events organised across 24+ cities, and 60,000 guests, The Best Event is a leader in the space. From bespoke and intimate meetups, to large-scale parties at the likes of Marquee and E11even Miami, we bring together the boldest creators, top brands, and visionaries shaping the future for unforgettable experiences.

For sponsor inquiries [for the penthouse editions, please contact Mihir via Telegram](https://t.me/mihirodhrani) or email mihir@tbv.xyz.

### About the event

Saturday's Formula 1 program at the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix includes the Sprint and Grand Prix qualifying at the Marina Bay Street Circuit.

### Saturday, 10 October

The track program runs on local Singapore time: the Porsche Carrera Cup Asia qualifying session at 15:00-15:30, the Formula 1 Sprint of 21 laps or 60 minutes at 17:00-17:30, the Formula 1 press conference at 17:30-18:00, the Porsche Carrera Cup Asia first race at 19:45-20:20, the Grand Prix qualifying session at 21:00-22:00, and a further press conference at 22:00-23:00.

### Circuit

The night race takes place at the 4.927-kilometre Marina Bay Street Circuit. The official timetable is subject to change.

The Marina Bay Circuit arrived on the scene in 2008 with the city skyline as its backdrop, hosting the first night-time race in Formula 1 history. After a 2023 layout change the lap runs 19 corners over 4.927 kilometres, and the bumpy street surface plus humidity make it one of the most physically demanding races on the calendar.

### Following the weekend

The sessions can be followed live on F1 TV, with tickets and hospitality packages available through Formula 1 official channels.

## A Global Living Lab: Light DAO's Next International Gathering

- Record: `luma-host-evt-evt-T1nhxzU2JSJPAgq`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-11T06:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://lu.ma/LightDAOEdgeCity>
- Original page: <https://luma.com/LightDAOEdgeCity>

### About the event

Members of Light DAO's leadership recently participated in Edge Esmeralda and came away feeling it was one of the most impressive, inspiring and transformative business gatherings we had ever experienced - because it was not a conference, retreat or summit.

It was a Society Incubator - an extraordinary integration of worlds that are rarely found in one place.

In a single day, you might:

Begin the morning with a tea ceremony, breathwork or yoga

Move into a talk with brilliant researchers, founders and investors on frontier science and emerging technology

Spend a few hours building software, testing experimental health wearables, collaborating in a maker space, or creating in a media lab

Head into nature, join a wellness session, or get absorbed in a discussion on the latest in AI agents, fintech or longevity

Continue the conversations over dinner late into the evening - or end the night with music, ecstatic dance or a calming sound bath

For families, dedicated programs for kids and teens, starting at age 4, offer opportunities to play, learn, create and build within their own community

Alongside all of this are deep conversations about consciousness, philosophy, society and human flourishing

It felt like stepping into a living laboratory for the future - a temporary village designed to explore and experiment with how we might live, work, learn, build and thrive differently.

It offered a glimpse of what the world could look like when innovation, human flourishing and community are developed together.

### This is Edge City

Edge Cities are 3-4-week Living Labs and Society Incubators - international popup villages where frontier technology, science, entrepreneurship, consciousness, culture, art, well-being and community are not separate tracks, but part of one shared environment.

Edge Cities have already taken place in Patagonia, Chiang Mai, Cape Town and Esmeralda, two hours north of San Francisco.

Edge Esmeralda - June 2026

- 850 residents from 60+ countries
- Nearly 300 stayed for the full month
- 800+ sessions and experiments
- Families came with 48 kids

What made it so extraordinary was being surrounded by brilliant, conscious innovators genuinely committed to advancing humanity - with enough time together for real relationships, collaborations and radical ideas to develop.

[www.EdgeEsmeralda.com](https://www.EdgeEsmeralda.com)

That experience convinced us that Edge City offers something unusually valuable for the Light DAO community.

So this October, we're taking our community to the next Edge City.

### The Next Edge City: Goa, India

October 11 - November 1, 2026

We're taking our community to Edge India in Goa - a three-week Living Lab and Society Incubator with hundreds of participants, approximately 65% coming from outside India.

Light DAO will have our own RESIDENCY within the larger Edge India community, so our members can take part in the full Edge experience while also connecting more intimately with our own community.

### A Living Lab Created by Its Community

One of the things that make Edge Cities especially unique and powerful is their unconference-style format. Much of the experience is created by the participants themselves - through the talks, demos, experiments and working groups they lead around the ideas and projects they care most about.

Light DAO will also host more intimate gatherings within our own Residency, led by our guests.

Once registered, Light DAO Owner Members are welcome to contact us with ideas you might like to lead or contribute to. We can't guarantee a place in either the Light DAO or Edge programming, but we'd love to hear what you are most excited to share.

That participatory spirit is part of what makes Edge a true Living Lab: the community does not simply attend the experience - it helps create it.

### A Special Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency

We're delighted to be partnering with SingularityNET for a 3-week Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency at Edge India. This is the first collaboration of its kind we've run with the SingularityNET team.

Everyone racing toward AGI is making the same bet: that a bigger model gets there. SingularityNET is not.

Led by Dr. Ben Goertzel, who launched the term and concept of Artificial General Intelligence, the team scales Beneficial General Intelligence on Hyperon, a cognitive architecture with two decades of research behind it. It holds knowledge, goals and decisions in a form you can inspect, shows its reasoning, and runs under explicit permissions - which is what makes it deployable inside real institutions.

The residency puts you in the room with the people building it. Talks, working sessions and open build time for developers, founders, researchers, investors, and anyone serious about AGI, ASI and beneficial technology.

Bring what you are already building. Leave with something concrete: a technical integration, a partnership, an investment conversation, or a prototype you put together on-site at Edge India.

### Why Join the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency?

In addition to the full Edge India experience, our Residency gives you a more intimate community to connect, collaborate and build with throughout your stay, including:

Light DAO + SingularityNET talks, working sessions and open build time

More intimate conversations and collaborations within our residency group, particularly with SingularityNET's leadership and tech team.

Light DAO-organized meals, including opportunities for participants to lead topic conversations

Optional group outings and shared experiences

Opportunities for Light DAO Owner Members to propose topics they may want to lead or contribute to

A shared home base at our beachfront resort

Think of our residency as your home community within the larger Edge India Living Lab.

### What Makes Edge Cities a Unique Living Lab + Society Incubator

Hear Edge Cities co-founder Timour Kosters talk about the multidisciplinary, multigenerational and global vision behind Edge Cities - including its unconference format and experiments.

He shares how the experience stretches people's sense of what is possible, helps them embody that expansion, and activates new collaborations and directions. In 1-3 weeks, many participants accelerate results that might otherwise have taken months or longer.

The Edge experience is designed around focused work, collaboration, wellness, community and time to enjoy Goa.

Your Edge Pass includes the full Edge India experience - programming, coworking, wellness, community gatherings and more.

### Pricing

Edge India Pass

Prices increase weekly

- 2-3 weeks (same price): $1,500-$2,000
- 1 week: $750-$1,000
- Day pass: $150-$200
- Indian citizens: 50% discount

Our Beachfront 4-Star Resort

[www.RivaResorts.com](https://www.RivaResorts.com)

Our Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency will be based at Edge India's central hotel.

- Private room + breakfast: $100 per room/night
- Lunch + dinner: approximately $30 - 50/day
  Your choice - at the resort or anywhere in Goa

Yes - you get your own private room. At $100/night including breakfast, this is an exceptional value for a beachfront 4-star resort.

If you're coming as a couple, it is the same $100/night including breakfast for 2!

Roommates also the same $100/night!

Lunches, dinners and excursions are paid for individually, giving you the flexibility to join our residency plans, other Edge activities, or your own plans in Goa.

### Joining the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency

Edge Cities are curated communities with an application and approval process.

Light DAO Owner Members and friends we already know:

Please RSVP here on Luma. You will automatically be approved for Edge India through our Residency.

If you are new to us:

Please RSVP here on Luma and complete the registration questions thoughtfully. Thank you.

Once approved through the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency, you will not need to complete a separate Edge City application.

Ready to Join?

Choose one of the two ticket options above.

Once approved, we'll send you:

- the direct link to purchase your Edge ticket at the current lowest price
- the resort reservation link

Come experience our collaboration between Edge Cities, SingularityNET and Light DAO - where frontier ideas, deep community and real opportunities to build and collaborate come together in one Living Lab.

You may leave with a partnership, a prototype, a new collaborator, or an entirely new direction you had not imagined before joining this unique Society Incubator.

### About the event

The Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2026 takes place over 62 laps of the 4.927-kilometre Marina Bay Street Circuit on Sunday, 11 October.

### Sunday race program

The track program runs on local Singapore time, eight hours ahead of UTC: the Porsche Carrera Cup Asia second race at 15:40-16:15, the drivers' parade at 18:00-18:30, the national anthem at 19:44-19:46, and the Grand Prix of 62 laps or 120 minutes at 20:00-22:00.

### Circuit

The Marina Bay Circuit is a street track with the city's skyline as its backdrop and has hosted the night race since 2008. The official timetable is subject to change.

The Marina Bay Circuit arrived on the scene in 2008 with the city skyline as its backdrop, hosting the first night-time race in Formula 1 history. After a 2023 layout change the lap runs 19 corners over 4.927 kilometres, and the bumpy street surface plus humidity make it one of the most physically demanding races on the calendar.

### Following the weekend

The sessions can be followed live on F1 TV, with tickets and hospitality packages available through Formula 1 official channels.

### About the event

Join us for MyWeb3's Official Launch Party! Come set up your profile during our hands-on platform training session, enjoy free food & drinks, and network with local Orange County business owners.

MyWeb3 gives creators, SMBs, artists, musicians, and more a free, personalized page to grow their following and customer base. Easily gain new followers across your platforms and let customers pay or donate however they want: PayPal, Venmo, Zelle, CashApp, Crypto, and more.

Tip: Bring your laptop and brand logo so we can help you set up your profile!

In addition, you can download and customize the following Profile Picture and Banner templates

Templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/16TJ3nQ-peuicObRWBE0NiYhj16xpd4-O?usp=sharing

Live Version launching soon with new features.

Powered by Lost Art

## Money 20/20 USA

- Record: `ma-money-20-20-usa`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-18T00:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed

### About the event

Money20/20 USA runs in Las Vegas from October 18 to 21, 2026, bringing together banking, payments, technology, retail and fintech participants. The current agenda highlights agentic AI, fraud, finance as a service, payments and regulation. Announced speakers include PNC chairman and CEO William Demchak, Early Warning CEO Cameron Fowler and Adyen chief risk and compliance officer Mariëtte Swart.

Attendees can use Money20/20 Connect in the app or browser to book one-to-one meetings. The event also includes an exhibition and evening gatherings; the organizer advertises a Timbaland DJ set at OMNIA as part of Money By Night. Check your pass conditions for access to individual activities.

## AI x Crypto: Innovation, Efficiency and Staying Safe in a New Digital Economy

- Record: `luma-host-evt-evt-pFcQwUTOA8oLMMD`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-20T17:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://lu.ma/encode-mmls>
- Original page: <https://luma.com/encode-mmls>

### AI x Crypto: Innovation, Efficiency and Staying Safe in a New Digital Economy

Artificial intelligence is rapidly reshaping the crypto and blockchain landscape, moving beyond basic automation into smart research, dynamic risk management, and adaptive trading tools that can help users process information and navigate increasingly complex digital markets.

However, operating at the speed of AI presents a fresh set of challenges. Fast execution, complex automated tools, and shifting market environments mean users need to understand not just the opportunities, but how to navigate potential technical limits and emerging risks safely.

Join this educational discussion to explore the opportunities and challenges at the intersection of AI and crypto. We will look at how AI is transforming the sector, what users should be aware of, and the practical steps everyone can take to use emerging tools more safely and responsibly.

### Discussion Topics

- How AI is transforming crypto: The role of AI in blockchain products, user experiences, data analysis, customer support, security monitoring and operational efficiency.
- New products and opportunities: How AI-enabled tools are changing the way people interact with wallets, decentralised applications, market information and digital-asset platforms.
- Efficiency and automation: Where AI can help simplify complex processes, improve access to information and support better decision-making.
- Understanding Tool Capabilities & Limits: Knowing what AI can and cannot do
- Responsible Adoption & Oversight: Building the core financial knowledge and critical-thinking habits needed to guide AI tools safely, rather than relying on them blindly.

### Schedule

- 6.30pm - Welcome, registration and check in
- 7.15pm - Fireside chat
- 7.45pm - Networking drinks and pizzas
- 9:30pm - Doors close

### Speakers

Simon Babakhani - CEO, Zebec

As Zebec's co-founder, Simon brings 10+ years of leadership experience from senior roles in private equity and advisory at Breyer Capital, Parthenon, and Oliver Wyman

Lucia Camarillo- Marketing Manager UK, Bitget (moderator)

A seasoned marketing professional with nine years of global, in-house experience - including over three years specialising in the Web3 sector - driving growth across startups, scale-ups, and established enterprises. She is currently Marketing Manager at Bitget, a leading crypto exchange serving over 125 million users worldwide. Passionate about making Web3 accessible, Lucia frequently shares her expertise through industry conferences and webinars. Specialising in integrated field marketing, she designs high-impact experiences that accelerate demand, build robust pipelines, and deepen customer engagement across the Fintech landscape.

### [About Zebec]

https://zebec.io/

Zebec is a leader in global stablecoin payroll, processing $500M+ in volume across 280+ enterprise clients. Since 2021, we've built an ecosystem spanning payroll, payments, banking infrastructure, and multi-chain Mastercard-backed cards, enabling enterprises to pay employees globally in real time and give them instant access to their funds.

### [About Bitget]

https://www.bitget.com/en-GB

Bitget is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange serving over 125 million users worldwide. In the UK market, the platform delivers an innovation-driven spot trading experience featuring access to over 200 digital assets. Backed by a 300 million dollar protection fund and advanced security infrastructure, Bitget actively drives mainstream crypto adoption through structured educational initiatives, including its Blockchain4Youth and Blockchain4Her programs. Furthermore, as part of its global impact strategy, Bitget has partnered with UNICEF to provide essential blockchain education to 1.1 million people by 2027.

### [About Encode]

https://www.encodeclub.com/

A global developer community empowering builders through hackathons, accelerators, and educational [programmes. They also offer a vibrant coworking space](https://hub.encodeclub.com/) in the heart of Shoreditch, London!

## AI & Fintech XRPL Hackathon in New York

- Record: `w3v-xrp-ledger-hackathon`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-24T12:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/xrpl-hackathon-nyc>

### About the event

Developers, product managers, designers, and business minds: team up and ship a working product in one weekend, from AI agents to new financial apps, with mentors and judges from across the AI, tech, blockchain, and finance world.

Hosted by XRPL Commons (https://www.xrpl-commons.org), with partners Ripple (https://www.ripple.com), XRPL Foundation (https://www.xrpl.foundation/), Mastercard (https://www.mastercard.com), Ledger (https://www.ledger.com/), AWS (https://aws.amazon.com/) and Quicknode (https://www.quicknode.com/). Whether it's your first hackathon, your fiftieth, or you want to sprint to launch a new feature, there's a place for you.

Join NYC's builder community for a weekend of shipping, then walk into Swell (https://swell.ripple.com/), Ripple's flagship conference, where institutions, investors, and decision-makers are already gathered, with a story to tell.

### Who it's for

- Developers: no need to learn a new coding language. Build with the ones you already know, like JavaScript or Python.
- Product, business, and finance profiles: you don't need to code. Great teams need people who shape the idea, design the user experience, build the business case, and pitch the demo.
- AI-native builders welcome: use your favorite AI coding tools and agent frameworks to move faster.
- Come solo and find a team on site, or bring your own.

4 Tracks

All projects must be built on the XRP Ledger (https://xrpl.org), a fast, low-cost blockchain designed for payments and digital finance. New to it? Mentors will help you get started.

- Agentic Finance: build the tools that let AI agents make payments and manage money on the XRP Ledger, autonomously, safely, and at machine speed.
- Lending & Borrowing: build lending apps and savings vaults on brand-new financial infrastructure (XRP Ledger Lending Protocol and Single Asset Vaults), before it goes live.
- Protocol Innovation: for C++ and systems engineers who want to work on core infrastructure, clients, and developer tooling. Paired with a 3-day Core Dev Bootcamp (Oct 20-22) (http://luma.com/xrpl-core-dev-bootcamp2) as your on-ramp.
- Why Not: the open lane. Bring the XRP Ledger project you can't stop thinking about.

Already building?

Bring an existing project, AI app, or startup and use the 36 hours to ship a new feature on XRP Ledger. Only what you build during the hackathon counts toward judging.

What you get: $40,000+ in prizes, including stackable sponsored-track prizes, plus hands-on mentorship, fast-track access to grants and incubation, and a direct line to hiring teams.

Mentors & Judges

Ripple (https://ripple.com) - XRPL Foundation (https://xrplf.org) - Mastercard (https://www.mastercard.com) - Ledger (https://www.ledger.com) - Quicknode (https://www.quicknode.com) - AWS (https://aws.amazon.com/) - t54.ai (https://www.t54.ai/) - Evernorth (https://www.evernorth.xyz/) - Soil (https://soil.co/) and more

Registration details

By registering for this event, you consent to being photographed and filmed, and to the use of these photos/videos for promotional purposes.

All participants are required to agree with and adhere to the code of conduct (https://swell.ripple.com/code-of-conduct).

## Hacker House Goa 2026

- Record: `w3v-hacker-house-goa-26-10-28`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-28
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://hacker-house-goa-2026.devfolio.co/>

### About the event

Builders and founders gather in Goa ahead of Devcon India for a multi-day residency focused on product development, smart contracts and community collaboration. The house brings together developers, designers and protocol contributors to prototype decentralized applications, conduct technical peer reviews and prepare for the upcoming Ethereum hackathons in Mumbai.

### What to expect

Participants take part in daily co-working sprints, technical workshops and evening demo circles. The program covers smart contract security, account abstraction, layer-2 infrastructure and decentralized finance integrations. Seasoned mentors provide feedback on architecture and project roadmaps. High-speed connectivity, ergonomic workstations, and communal meals are provided throughout the residency.

### Who should attend

The residency welcomes Web3 developers, Solidity engineers, UX designers and founders actively building open-source projects or preparing submissions for Devcon and India Blockchain Week hackathons.

### Venue and schedule

The hacker house runs in Goa from October 31 to November 4, 2026. The exact residential villa address is shared directly with accepted participants upon application approval.

### Registration and admission

Participation is free with application review required. Applications are evaluated based on project proposals, GitHub contributions, and community impact. Confirmed guests receive onboarding packages and arrival instructions.

## MIP-20: Road to Devcon

- Record: `ethorg-meetupmip-20--road-to-devconoct-24mumbai--india--o`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-30T09:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/ndrr1yqe>

### About the event

ETHMumbai hosts MIP-20: Road to Devcon on Friday, October 30, 2026, from 15:00 to 18:00 IST. The pre-conference developer meetup introduces the Mumbai Improvement Proposal 20 and highlights local Ethereum contributions.

### What to expect

The session features technical presentations and community discussions:

- An introduction to the MIP-20 specification and its role in developer tooling, node operations, and ecosystem standards for Mumbai's developer community.
- Workshops on building decentralized applications with modern Ethereum stacks, account abstraction (ERC-4337), and zero-knowledge toolkits.
- Hackathon readiness briefings, offering advice on forming teams, identifying bounties, and preparing for ETHIndia and Devcon hackathons.

### About the event

Orviq Labs presents Run & Rave in Mumbai on Sunday, November 1, 2026, from 06:00 to 08:00 IST. The morning wellness activation blends distance running, electronic music, and community networking ahead of India Blockchain Week and Devcon 8.

### What to expect

Run & Rave kickstarts the week with a sunrise run through the coastal streets of Bandra. A mobile DJ rig guides the group with upbeat house beats, creating an energetic and uplifting rhythm. The route is paved and scenic, offering views of the Arabian Sea. Following the run, participants gather for freshly brewed artisanal coffee, electrolyte drinks, healthy breakfast bites, and relaxed networking with founders, builders, and creators.

### Who should attend

All runners, joggers, and walkers of any pace are welcome, from seasoned marathoners to casual morning runners. It is perfect for crypto founders, developers, and creators who want to prioritize health and movement before a hectic week of conferences.

### Venue and schedule

The run starts and finishes in Bandra, Mumbai, on Sunday, November 1, beginning at 06:00 IST and concluding by 08:00 IST.

### Registration and admission

Registration is free via Luma. Running shoes and comfortable sports clothing are required. Hydration points are stationed along the route, with baggage storage available at the start point.

## Catalyst - Founder residency at Devcon

- Record: `w3v-catalyst-founder-residency-devcon-26-11-01`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-01T17:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/jb4zsel1>

### About the event

Web3 Events hosts Catalyst: Founder Residency during Devcon week in Mumbai, running from Tuesday, November 3, through Saturday, November 7, 2026. The residency provides a curated co-living and collaborative headquarters for active crypto startup founders.

### What to expect

Catalyst creates an intensive, high-support environment where founders can work, sleep, and connect throughout Devcon week:

- Dedicated high-speed fiber internet work desks, private phone booths, and meeting rooms for investor calls.
- Daily peer masterminds and founder circles addressing hiring, token design, and growth challenges.
- Private office hours with visiting venture capitalists, angel investors, and experienced operators.
- Daily catered breakfast, coffee, late-night brain food, and quiet workspaces away from the noisy conference floors.

### Who should attend

The residency is strictly reserved for founders, CEOs, and technical co-founders of venture-backed or bootstrapped Web3 startups building core protocol infrastructure or breakthrough consumer applications.

### Venue and schedule

The residency operates 24 hours a day from November 3 through November 7 at a private hospitality facility in Mumbai located near major conference transit lines.

### Registration and admission

Applications are evaluated based on project traction, team background, and stage of development. Approved founders receive check-in credentials, residency passes, and room details.

## BORN UP — Devcon Mumbai Community Networking Meetup

- Record: `luma-evt-VMyghZX4k8su1uQ`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-03T06:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://lu.ma/4al1ai5x>

### About the event

The BORN UP community hosts the Devcon Mumbai Community Networking Meetup on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, from 17:00 to 20:00 IST. The meetup empowers grass-roots builders, student developers, and emerging Web3 talent visiting Devcon 8.

### What to expect

The three-hour program is designed to foster community growth and collaboration:

- Lightning talks highlighting grass-roots Web3 projects, open-source developer tooling, and community initiatives in India.
- Mentorship speed-dating connecting experienced blockchain founders with early-stage developers and student hackathon teams.
- Portfolio reviews, smart contract security tips, and career advice for engineers transitioning into decentralized technology.
- Open networking with snacks, tea, and refreshments in an inclusive, welcoming setting.

### Who should attend

The meetup is tailored for early-career developers, university blockchain club members, hackathon participants, open-source contributors, and community leaders.

### Venue and schedule

The event takes place at a community coworking hub in Mumbai on Wednesday, November 4, running from 17:00 to 20:00 IST.

### Registration and admission

Admission is free of charge via Luma. RSVP approval is required to manage venue capacity. Approved guests receive the full address and transit directions.

## Zyhperpunks Dinner @Devcon

- Record: `luma-evt-Mr3xwAWeAXMdGam`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-03T13:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/jlisaxzz>

### About the event

Zcash and Harsh Bajpai host the Zyhperpunks Dinner in Mumbai on November 3, 2026, from 19:30 to 22:30 IST during Devcon week. The evening brings together privacy researchers, cryptographers and cypherpunks for an intimate dinner and technical conversation on zero-knowledge privacy.

### What to expect

The program begins with a 30-minute overview of recent Zcash technical developments, network scalability improvements, and user-facing privacy tools. Attendees participate in an interactive onboarding clinic using the Zashi shielded wallet to experience private transactions firsthand. The presentation transitions into a multi-course dinner with open roundtable discussions on financial sovereignty, regulatory compliance through selective disclosure, and the state of client-side ZK-proofs.

### Who should attend

This gathering is tailored for privacy advocates, zero-knowledge engineers, cryptography researchers, and open-source contributors passionate about preserving privacy and freedom in decentralized networks.

### Venue and schedule

The dinner takes place in the Ram Krishna Nagar neighborhood of Khar West / Bandra, Mumbai, on Tuesday, November 3, running from 19:30 to 22:30 IST.

### Registration and admission

Attendance is free and requires host approval to maintain an intimate table size conducive to deep technical discussions. Venue address and directions will be shared directly with approved guests.

## EVA Symposium III

- Record: `w3v-eva-symposium-iii-26-11-04`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-04T11:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/ai6owvhz>

### About the event

EVA Research hosts the EVA Symposium III in Mumbai on Monday, November 2, 2026, from 10:00 to 16:00 IST during Devcon week. The formal academic and research symposium gathers leading cryptographers, computer scientists, and zero-knowledge researchers.

### What to expect

The full-day symposium features peer-reviewed paper presentations, invited keynotes, and technical whiteboard panels:

- Formal verification of smart contracts and consensus state transition systems.
- Zero-Knowledge Virtual Machines (zkVMs): comparing proof recursion, lookup arguments, and constraint system efficiency.
- Cryptographic primitives for verifiable computation, polynomial commitments, and folding schemes.
- Open whiteboard workshops where researchers collaborate on unsolved problems in protocol security.

A catered luncheon and coffee breaks provide ample networking time between sessions.

### Who should attend

The symposium is aimed at cryptography researchers, computer science faculty and graduate students, formal verification engineers, and zero-knowledge protocol architects.

### Venue and schedule

The symposium takes place at a conference auditorium in Mumbai on Monday, November 2, from 10:00 to 16:00 IST.

### Registration and admission

Attendance is free with registration approval required. Applicants are asked to share their academic affiliation, research papers, or GitHub profiles when requesting admission.

### About the event

The Money Layer Consortium presents Money Layer @Devcon Week in Mumbai on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, from 14:00 to 18:00 IST. The four-hour conference explores digital cash, programmable payments, and decentralized settlement infrastructure.

### What to expect

The afternoon conference brings together leaders from monetary protocol design, banking, and crypto-native commerce:

- Keynote on the evolution of digital cash: from sovereign stablecoins to privacy-preserving ecash (Cashu, Fedimint).
- Panel on scalable payment channels: Lightning Network, state channels, and Layer 2 payment streaming protocols.
- Merchant adoption case studies: deploying point-of-sale crypto payments across retail and e-commerce platforms with zero chargeback risk.
- Regulatory frameworks for programmable payments, automated tax withholding, and programmable escrow.

The presentations conclude with an open tea and networking reception.

### Who should attend

The conference is tailored for payments product managers, fintech executives, monetary economists, stablecoin developers, and Web3 engineers building consumer checkout flows.

### Venue and schedule

The event takes place at a conference auditorium in Mumbai on Wednesday, November 4, from 14:00 to 18:00 IST.

### Registration and admission

Attendance is free with registration approval required on Luma. Registered attendees receive presentation decks and speaker summaries following the conference.

## Perps & Chai with HyprEarn @Devcon 8

- Record: `w3v-perps--chai-with-hyprearn`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-06T11:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/58b4n6e6>

### About the event

HyprEarn hosts Perps & Chai with HyprEarn @Devcon 8 in Mumbai on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, from 15:00 to 18:00 IST. The afternoon meetup combines traditional Mumbai chai culture with cutting-edge discussions on decentralized perpetual contracts and yield generation.

### What to expect

The session brings together derivatives traders and DeFi developers over traditional afternoon tea:

- Live demonstration of HyprEarn's perpetual yield strategies, automated vault rebalancing, and delta-neutral earning vaults.
- Discussions on perpetual DEX liquidity fragmentation, funding rate arbitrage, and oracle latency mitigation.
- Freshly brewed authentic Mumbai cutting chai, masala chai, herbal infusions, and traditional savory snacks like samosas and kachoris.
- Casual whiteboard sessions and networking with quantitative developers and risk managers.

### Who should attend

The meetup is tailored for perpetual DEX traders, DeFi yield farmers, smart contract engineers, liquidity providers, and quantitative finance enthusiasts.

### Venue and schedule

The event takes place at a private hospitality lounge in the Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), Mumbai, on Wednesday, November 4, from 15:00 to 18:00 IST.

### Registration and admission

Admission is free and approval-based on Luma. Space is limited to ensure a comfortable cafe setting. Approved attendees will receive the venue address upon confirmation.

### About the event

Web3 Events hosts an energetic community Devcon Afterparty in Mumbai on Friday, November 6, 2026, from 21:30 IST until 01:00 on November 7. ### What to expect

The evening features live DJ performances, a curated selection of cocktails and drinks, and open-floor social networking. ### About the event

Secret Society presents ETHwali, a special community celebration in Mumbai on Sunday, November 8, 2026, from 18:00 to 23:30 IST. The event unites the international Ethereum community to celebrate the Hindu festival of lights, Diwali, in authentic Indian style.

### What to expect

ETHwali transforms the venue into a vibrant festival of lights, honoring culture, friendship, and collective success:

- Traditional Diwali lighting with earthen lamps (diyas), rangoli floor art, and festive floral decor.
- Authentic Indian festive cuisine, including regional street food stations, savory delicacies, and celebratory sweets (mithai).
- Live cultural music, acoustic sets, and upbeat DJ performances.
- Heartfelt community toasts reflecting on milestones achieved across Devcon and India Blockchain Week.

### Who should attend

The celebration warmly welcomes local and international Ethereum developers, researchers, founders, community managers, and their partners looking to experience traditional Indian festive culture and close out Devcon week together.

### Venue and schedule

The celebration takes place at a festive rooftop and banquet venue in Mumbai on Sunday evening, November 8, from 18:00 to 23:30 IST. Traditional Indian attire or smart-casual wear is celebrated.

### Registration and admission

Tickets are free via Luma and subject to venue capacity limits. Registration is free and requires host approval. Guests receive the full venue coordinates and dress code details upon confirmation.

## The (un)Banked Conference

- Record: `w3v-the-unbanked-conference-london`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)

### About the event

The (un)Banked is going to London.

After a successful first edition in Amsterdam, we're bringing the conference to the City on 9th of November. The FCA has published its final cryptoasset rules, Lloyds has settled a tokenised deposit on a public blockchain, and the major banks in the City now have dedicated digital asset teams. The question is no longer whether financial infrastructure moves on-chain, but who will operate it when it does.

That question sits at the centre of the programme. Across five panels on tokenisation, custody, stablecoins, institutional capital and regulation, we put banks, fintechs and crypto companies on the same stage to work through it together, with curated networking between sessions to continue the conversation.

### Who should attend

Senior executives, investors, and decision-makers shaping the future of finance, across banking, fintech, and digital assets. Ideal for professionals driving strategy, investment, and innovation at the intersection of traditional financial systems and onchain infrastructure.

Where it happens

Landing Canary Wharf - 12 Bank Street, London

London's flagship design-led venue, located in the heart of the capital's most connected business district.

How It Was in Amsterdam

Our debut edition brought together 500+ senior leaders from banking, fintech, and digital assets for an evening of high-level conversation and networking.

[Learn more about the previous edition at theunbanked.finance](https://theunbanked.finance)

This year, we're bringing that same energy to London. Speaker lineup to be announced soon - but first, here's who took over the room in Amsterdam.

[Community Partner - Introduction.com](https://Introduction.com)

[Introduction.com](https://Introduction.com) is a private global network anchored by a 400-member core community (7% acceptance rate) and amplified by a wider ecosystem of 500,000+ founders, investors, and operators.Our curated membership represents the executives and founders pioneering the future of tech and finance - from Web2 conglomerates like JP Morgan, Amazon, Google, and Stripe, to Web3 giants like Coinbase, Binance, a16z, and Pantera.

We meet globally to grow high-value relationships through curated events, strategic introductions, and sustained community engagement.

Hosted by INPUT Global

INPUT Global is a global communications partner for companies and founders across financial services, digital assets and emerging technology.

We build market credibility, recognition and influence through:

- PR & Strategic Communications - shaping narratives and building media presence

### About the event

Behind every great ecosystem are conversations that never make it onto the main stage.

The Purple Table is an invitation-only gathering for women building the future of technology, from founders and engineers to designers, creators, investors, and ecosystem leaders in the Solana ecosystem.

No panels. No pitches. Just one carefully curated table, meaningful conversations, and the people you'll still be talking to long after Breakpoint ends.

Seats are intentionally limited.

### About the event

BlockZero 2026 returns as a community-led summit for the Solana validator ecosystem.

Taking place in London on November 15, 2026, the event will bring together validators, infrastructure operators, protocol contributors, and teams building validator-adjacent technology for a focused day of discussion, coordination, and shared learning.

BlockZero is designed as a small, high-signal gathering for the people working closest to blockchain infrastructure. The program will focus on the operational, economic, and governance questions shaping the future of validator networks, with space for technical sessions, working groups, and open community-led dialogue.

More details on speakers, agenda, and participation will be announced soon.

Attendance is limited and subject to approval to preserve the collaborative format of the event.

## Pr1me London Series - Exclusive Dinner for Web3 Finance

- Record: `w3v-pr1me-london-series-exclusive-dinner-web3-26-11-16`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-16T19:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/aqntywn2>

### About the event

Join us for the [London edition of the PR1ME Series, during Solana Breakpoint](https://solana.com/breakpoint) powered by the Onchain Finance Institute (OCF), [Solana Foundation](https://solana.org/), [Lukka](https://lukka.tech/) [and Breezing](https://breezing.io/).

This invite-only, community-driven gathering brings together leading minds in web3 accounting and finance.

This event is exclusively for finance professionals - CFOs, COOs, Controllers, Heads of Finance, or equivalent. We're unable to accept applications outside these roles.

Important: Only confirmed guests with a QR code will be allowed entry. Please note that walk-ins or unapproved registrations will not be possible.

### About Solana Foundation

[The Solana Foundation](https://solana.org/) is a non-profit organisation based in Zug, Switzerland, dedicated to the decentralisation, growth, and security of the Solana network. Solana is a proof-of-stake blockchain built for mass adoption. Fast, composable, green, and globally distributed.

### About Lukka

[Lukka](https://lukka.tech/) is the institutional data backbone for digital assets, transforming fragmented on-chain and off-chain activity into audit-ready intelligence. Trusted by global financial institutions, asset managers, custodians, exchanges, and regulators, Lukka delivers the trust, truth, and transparency needed to power pricing, valuation, compliance, risk management, accounting, and reporting across digital and tokenized assets.

### About Breezing

[Breezing](https://breezing.io/) is a crypto subledger built specifically for accounting professionals managing digital assets. It connects directly to blockchains, exchanges, and accounting systems like Xero and QuickBooks, eliminating the manual work of exporting CSVs and posting journal entries by hand.

[Used by 200+ businesses including ht.digital](https://ht.digital), BDO, ETH Global, Safe, and Dune.

SOC 2 certified and Swiss-made🇨🇭.

### About Onchain Finance Institute (OCF)

Onchain Finance Institute (OCF) (https://www.onchainfinanceinstitute.com/) is an education and community platform helping finance professionals build real-world onchain finance skills for accounting, treasury, and finance roles.

Join 150+ alumni and 400+ community members from organizations such as Solana Foundation, a16z, Ava Labs, Starknet, and more, upskilling with digital assets and transitioning into the future of onchain finance.

[Apply to join community platform](https://www.onchainfinanceinstitute.com/community).

> For sponsorship inquiries, you can reach out to hello@theaccountantquits.com

### Highlights from Past Events

PR1ME Cayman Islands Series

PR1ME Singapore Series

PR1ME Dubai Series

### About the event

CryptoMondays Wall Street, Fort Lauderdale & Miami Chapters Host The Official Blockchain Futurist Conference Kickoff Social

CryptoMondays isn't just a meetup; it's a global decentralized movement energizing Web3 and crypto communities through learning, networking, and inspiration.

CryptoMondays Wall Street, Fort Lauderdale and Miami Chapters are proud to host the [official opening event for the Blockchain Futurist Conference](https://www.futuristconference.com/) Florida for the 2nd year. This iconic global conference is coming to the USA and to Florida!

Join us Monday, November 16, 2026, as we welcome attendees, innovators, and the global Web3 community before the main event at the Hard Rock Guitar Hotel.

Monday, November 16, 2026

6:00 PM - 9:00 PM

Location Revealed Upon

CryptoMondays is a proud Community Partner of Blockchain Futurist Conference, working alongside the Futurist team to make this an unforgettable launch in Florida.

We're [also excited to announce our media partner Blockchain North](https://blockchainnorth.ca/), joining us to amplify the energy, stories, and innovation coming out of South Florida's crypto scene.

Why Attend?

- Be part of the official kickoff for the 2nd Futurist Conference in the USA.
- Network with industry leaders, investors, founders, and innovators.
- Get early access to community-driven insights before the main conference.
- Score free drink tickets just for sharing your experience on social media.
- Connect with sponsors and potential partners in a relaxed, fun setting.

This is the OFFICIAL Opening Event of Blockchain Futurist Conference; don't miss it!

RSVP now, bring your friends, and let's set the tone for the future of blockchain, right here in South Florida! Get updates as we confirm more speakers, special guests, and surprises.

By RSVPing to any of our events, you agree to be added to our future correspondence. You confirm that the email provided is active and in good standing, and you consent to opt into receiving updates and communications from us.

## University Blockchain Conference 2026

- Record: `luma-evt-mPCGxeHyKlTeEgN`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-20T15:00:00.000Z

### About the event

UBC: Where Talent Meets Opportunity

The University Blockchain Conference (UBC) - formerly the Midwest Blockchain Conference - is the leading access point connecting top university talent with the blockchain industry across the U.S. and beyond.

What started in the heartland of Ann Arbor has grown into a national movement and global network, now spanning 100+ universities including schools in South America and Europe. This year, we're evolving - new name, new home, same mission.

Built by students for students, UBC brings together university clubs, high schools, alumni, and industry leaders, all focused on pushing crypto forward through student leadership.

Connecting Top Talent with Leading Companies

If you're a student or faculty member passionate about blockchain, this is your gateway. This November, connect with dozens of hiring companies, VCs eager to invest, and thought leaders excited to share knowledge with the next generation of builders.

If you're an industry professional, UBC offers unmatched exposure to over 1000+ ambitious students and dozens of elite university programs, many of which have traditionally been difficult to reach. Grow your user base, recruit standout talent, and shape the future of the space.

Bigger Than Ever - Real Outcomes

UBC 2026 is set to surpass every prior year in every dimension: More speakers. More sponsors. More opportunities.

And it's working. Past attendees landed roles at:

Coinbase, Circle, Gemini, Galaxy, Polymarket, and many leading companies in blockchain, fintech, and policy.

This year, expect world-class speakers from industry and government, a major hackathon and research competition, tons of networking opportunities, massive side events, and as always, fire merch.

Hosted at The University of Texas at Austin

Set in Austin, one of America's fastest-growing tech and innovation hubs, UT Austin is a national leader in engineering, finance, and entrepreneurship. Its leading blockchain club, Texas Blockchain, and its thriving blockchain community make it the perfect host for UBC 2026.

Get Your Ticket

Early bird tickets are just $10 for students and $25 for industry. This small fee ensures attendees are committed and helps us better plan for an exceptional experience. UBC is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, student-run effort.

** IMPORTANT NOTE: If you are a student, make sure to apply for a travel subsidy here: https://forms.gle/GohTNo6bbxkGesXx7

Subsidy requests are approved by the team on a case-by-case basis. We aim to subsidize every student who travels to Austin for this event.

[Reserve your spot now]

### About the Organizers

College.xyz is a student-led 501(c)3 nonprofit connecting top university talent with the blockchain industry.

Beyond our flagship conference, we support students year-round through travel subsidies to events like Solana Breakpoint, sponsor hackathon tracks, and host side events at major conferences - all with the goal of onboarding more talent into the industry. We're building the next generation of blockchain leaders, on campus and beyond.

Contact Us

Interested in sponsoring, speaking, or volunteering?

Reach out at: uniblockchainconferences@gmail.com

Follow Us for Updates

Website: https://www.universityblockchain.org/

https://www.college.xyz/

### About the event

BlockCon Punta Cana is a Web3 business retreat at Barceló Bávaro Beach in the Dominican Republic from November 25 to 28, 2026. It covers finance, iGaming, venture capital, startups and the digital economy, including payments, stablecoins, tokenized assets and regulation.

The announced format includes panels, startup and VC matchmaking, banking and Web3 roundtables and networking. The Community Pass covers the conference and exhibition but excludes accommodation and retreat activities. Business passes add daytime activities and meetings; VIP All-Inclusive includes a hotel stay and additional experiences.

Check the organizer's current pass comparison for meal, activity and invitation-only access conditions.
